record_text:
Key points.
Coagulation and flocculation. Chemicals make fine particles clump into floc that can settle out.

In depth.
Coagulants neutralize the charges keeping tiny particles suspended; gentle mixing then builds them into fluffy floc. This first step removes the particles that make water cloudy.
